_comment: Hand-reviewed ACME CFI-G normal-flame tests for the demo. 'highlight' is a curator remark shown first in the case note; everything else in the note is copied from NASA source files. 21106F1 and 21130N5 were considered but left out: their recordings contain blocks of NUL bytes.

cases.highlight: Demo highlight: the source table records 5 transitions from hot to cool flame in one run.
Cool-flame run; compare with 21174C2, the hot-flame run just before it at nearly the same conditions.
Cool-flame run at a lower fuel flow than 21174C3.
Cool-flame run at conditions close to 21174C4.
Source comment reports a direct cool flame with no hot ignition.
Source comment reports a direct cool flame with no hot ignition.
No hot ignition at about half an atmosphere and 20.7% O2; compare with 21106G6, which burned at 21.0%.
Lowest-oxygen run in this selection that still ignited (18% O2).
No ignition at 20.7% O2; compare with 21162C1, which burned at 21.0% with a lower fuel flow.
Longest undiluted-propane flame in this selection.
No ignition; compare with 21112H1 at nearly the same atmosphere.
Highest-pressure run in this selection (about 3 atm).
